Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Anil - 32 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Anjali - 25 years, daughter
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Neeta - 62 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots
3. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Anil stands by the road. Neeta and Anjali stand near him.]

Anil: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Anil rides the scooter with Mother sitting behind him.]

Anjali: "Let's see."

[Anil takes Mother to the market on his motorbike, she sits behind him.]

Neeta: "Yes, all right."

Scene 2: The kitchen - Day

[Anjali stands in the kitchen. Neeta stands near her.]

Neeta: "Let's begin."

[Anjali rolls out rotis on the board.]

Neeta: "Yes, of course."

[Anjali stirs the dal in the pot.]

Anjali: "What happened?"

Scene 3: The main road - Day

[Anil stands on the road. Neeta and Anjali stand near him.]

Neeta: "Anil, look over here."

[Anil starts the car, turns the steering wheel and drives off.]

Anil: "Well done!"

[Anil is driving when he slams on the brakes.]

Anil (excited): "I really enjoyed today."
